card.name: Last letter of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final letter or letters of a newly coined, all-caps-style brand drug name (e.g. the Q in JESDUVROQ, O in IDVYNSO, Z in AVYCAZ). It appears in US prescribing information text.

modes.label: Name-ending letter
modes.description: A single closing letter completes an unusual brand name, after which the name is repeated in label text.

modes.description: A letter inside a brand name that is split into several pieces.
modes.example: If concomitant use cannot be avoided, increase ZEGFRO<<V>>Y dose.
